patch_summary: Guarded both --stream teardown blocks in vulnclaw/cli/main.py (run and solve) with isinstance(claims, list), degrading the int count from get_summary() to an empty findings list so emit_complete_event() always runs. Commits: test-only regression first, then the fix.
root_cause: Type contract mismatch: AgentState.get_summary() returns verified_claims as an int count, but the run/solve --stream teardown sliced it as a list; count > 0 raised TypeError: 'int' object is not subscriptable.
